reasons: All requested courses are included. Added CS2100 as the prerequisite for CS2106, CS3241 as the prerequisite for CS4247, and CS3263 as the prerequisite for CS4246 because CS2109S rules out CS3243.

Prerequisites are satisfied in strictly earlier semesters: CS2100 before CS2106; CS2103T before CS3219; CS2109S and ST2334 before CS3263; CS3263 before CS4246; CS3230 before CS4234; CS3241 before CS4247.
Offerings are respected: CS3231 and CS4234 are Sem 1 only; CS4247 is Sem 2 only; CS3241 is Sem 1 only.
At most 3 modules are planned per semester. CS2101 and ST2334 are in different semesters (CS2101 in semester 7, ST2334 in semester 4).
CS4234 cannot be placed in semester 6 because it is offered only in Sem 1; it is placed in semester 5 instead.
